title: Amazon API Gateway to AWS Lambda
description: Create an Amazon API Gateway to AWS Lambda HTTP API

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern creates an Amazon API Gateway API and an AWS Lambda function using AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) in Python. This template also has a sample CORS configuration. The sample application was developed in Python and it shows some context, event and environment variables properties.

testing.headline: Testing
text: Run the following command to send an HTTP GET request to the HTTP APIs endpoint. Note that you must edit the {api_endpoint} placeholder with the URL of the deployed HTTP APIs endpoint. This is provided in the deployment outputs.
The output will show a JSON object created by the sample application.
